purpose: VibeVoice-ASR Q4_K_M batched prefill: replace the row-by-row route with raw-block Q4_K/Q6_K WMMA prefill
hardware: AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ PRO 395, Radeon 8060S (gfx1151), 256-bit LPDDR5X, 133 GB unified

protocol.weights: Q4_K_M backbone (168 Q4_K + 28 Q6_K layer tensors), bf16 front-end + dense bf16 untied lm_head
protocol.kernels: gguf_q4_k_wmma_prefill_{bf16_f32,f32_f32}_out and gguf_q6_k_wmma_prefill_bf16_bf16_out read the unmodified GGUF block bytes; no repack, no fp16 weight copies, no extra resident memory
protocol.workload: 89-row prompt from tests/fixtures/vibevoice_asr/vibevoice_asr_lm.npz, 5 repetitions after one warmup, both lanes batched via prefill_rows in one process
protocol.command: python3 - <<'EOF' (load both lanes, time runtime.prefill_rows(buf, 89, 0) x5, then greedy_generate 16 tokens) EOF

per_gemm_at_146_rows.note: ms, raw-block WMMA prefill vs the naive raw-block prefill kernels on the same weights
per_gemm_at_146_rows.bf16_lane_reference: ~1.5 ms per GEMM average (196 GEMMs in ~0.30 s)

gates.gpu_suite: 8/8 tests/test_gpu_vibevoice_qwen2_q4_runner.py including the greedy chain 16/16 vs the torch fixture, first-position logits, and a new batched-vs-row-by-row prefill oracle
gates.prefill_numerics: batched vs row-by-row post-prefill: top-1 identical, top-5 set identical, max logit drift 5.9e-3 relative to the logit scale, cosine 0.99991
gates.wer_recheck: 20-clip Q4 lane with the batched prefill launched; the 50-clip gate and the 20-clip pack8-decode check are both 1.978% / 1.487% == bf16

notes: Q4_K now runs at or faster than the dense bf16 lane on both stages under a matched protocol: prefill 0.195 vs 0.296 s and decode 48.1 vs 72.2 ms/token, at 6.10 GB of resident weights against 16.66 GB.

Q6_K has no f32-output prefill entry point, so attn_v/ffn_down on half the layers land in a bf16 scratch and are widened once. Q6_K ffn_down is the slowest GEMM at 7.49 ms (21x over naive vs 107x for the Q4_K equivalent).
o_proj keeps f32 activations and uses the f32/f32 variant; the bf16 lane stages fp16 for hipBLASLt, which the Q4 route does not need at all.
Prefill scratch is allocated per call and released in finally; the route runs once per request.
